full_details: In the shop he spoke to you. Plays are a waste, and a waste with a crowd in it. You did not buy Daniel. Upstairs he spoke thou, and the second volume came down heavy as a hearthstone. It opened at a king, his uncles, a cousin banished, and a crown handed across. You read four columns on your feet. Jacqueline put a stool behind your knees, and then set a stack of quires where you stood, which ended the visit. You carried the book home through Cheapside in both arms. At night Brooke was closed. A new heading, Of Kings, took five lines and no speech. You copied the heralds at Coventry as an act of copying, and you did not begin the play.
one_sentence: You heard Field call plays a waste, read four columns of the second Richard standing, and carried Holinshed home.
title: Carried the second volume home and closed Verona
